title: Retail CDTM Schedule VI prescribing
rule_summary: A properly authorized retail collaborating pharmacist may issue Schedule VI prescriptions for the referred diagnosis and must send a copy to the supervising physician within 24 hours.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply schedule vi requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.
exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing schedule vi with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
